name: Write CHANGELOG.md from git history
prompt: This repository has a git history with two tagged releases (v1.0.0 and v1.1.0). Read the git history (e.g. git log --oneline --decorate) and write a CHANGELOG.md that lists the released versions and a one-line summary of what each release contained. Do not modify source files. The verification script checks that CHANGELOG.md mentions both released versions.
test_command: import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('CHANGELOG.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert '1.0.0' in t and '1.1.0' in t, 'CHANGELOG.md must mention released versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0'
